terms.gloss: the bashful embezzler who runs the 2nd Home of Sobes; recurs elsewhere

terms.gloss: Comrade Gritsatsuev, war invalid granted one chair; links to the widow Gritsatsueva later

terms.gloss: comic Soviet compound: a meat-chilling and slaughtering works, Ostap's fake trade

terms.gloss: merchant of the first guild, top tier of the pre-revolutionary merchant estate

terms.gloss: municipal communal-services department that officially owns the requisitioned furniture

terms.gloss: city military commissariat, the local draft/military-affairs office

terms.gloss: Stargorod provincial food-supply committee; a dense stack of clipped words

proposed.zh: 斯塔尔哥罗德省粮食委员会

terms.gloss: People's Commissariat of Foreign Trade
terms.why_hard: standard Narkom- acronym; use the established English calque and match it book-wide

terms.gloss: Main Tea Administration, the state tea monopoly's head office

terms.gloss: People's Commissariat of Education/Enlightenment, which took the ten chairs to a Moscow museum

terms.gloss: the housing department, and 'zavzhilotdelom' its head, who signed off a chair

terms.gloss: echo of Pushkin's 'Exegi monumentum' ('a monument not made by hands'); mock-solemn praise

terms.gloss: Ostap's pet malapropism, used to mean 'sheer genius / brilliant'
terms.why_hard: not English 'congenial'; keep the showy misused word rather than a plain 'brilliant'

proposed.en: It's congenial! (Ostap-speak for 'a stroke of genius')

proposed.ja: 実に天才的だ！（オスタップの誤用癖）

terms.gloss: made by the master Gambs, the famed St. Petersburg furniture firm; the twelve chairs are Gambs chairs

proposed.en: the work of the master Gambs

terms.gloss: a Soviet mill-construction trust; here a passing lorry stamped with the acronym

terms.gloss: a Soviet militia policeman

terms.gloss: the Krakowiak, a lively Polish folk dance; here the simile for his dodging footwork

terms.gloss: Soviet power/the Soviet authorities as the nationalizing agent

terms.gloss: 'the power of the workers and peasants', a stock revolutionary formula

terms.gloss: a member of the Communist Party

terms.gloss: the housing department of the local soviet

terms.gloss: an almshouse/poorhouse; the chair was bought there for three roubles

terms.gloss: a swindler/con man — Vorobyaninov's insult to the priest

Render Soviet acronyms and renamings (уисполком, улица товарища Губернского, 'плуг-и-молотовское') so the reader grasps them without a footnote while keeping the deadpan satire, and transliterate every personal name identically across en, zh and ja.
